turns.question: I'd love to hear about your coffee habits—think back to the last time you made a change with your coffee, whether that was trying something different, switching brands, or even just changing how you make it. What was going on at that time, and what made you decide to do something different?
turns.response: I switched to a French press like a year ago because I was just tired of the same instant stuff every morning. Nothing dramatic—my roommate had one and I'd use it sometimes and it actually tasted better, so I figured why not. Plus it's kind of a nice ritual in the morning, gives me a few extra minutes before I have to deal with everything else.

turns.question: Why does having those few minutes before everything else starts matter to you?
turns.response: Honestly, it's just the only time I'm actually by myself before the day gets chaotic. Once I'm at work or dealing with everything else, there's no space to just... be quiet for a bit. The coffee's kind of secondary to that, if that makes sense.
